claim_boundary: Illustrative seeded software runs on synthetic fixed rational tables, not a power study, an independent experiment, model efficiency evidence, a new generic testing method, or an improved original-instance minimax bound. Per-run counts need not be below expected bounds. Unsafe tables may validly receive statistical false certificates within the theorem's error allowance; observed false-certificate counts do not establish a general error rate.
description:
Frozen synthetic software demonstration of the cached reference auditor.

The fixed seeds illustrate execution and charged label counts; they do not
estimate power, prove a false-certificate rate, or measure any real model.

protocol.checks: One oracle call per item; exact trace and charge agreement; finite proposal caps; no certificate contradicting observed risk; all supported safe tables in this matrix complete; source bytes unchanged during calculation
protocol.claim_boundary: Illustrative seeded software runs on synthetic fixed rational tables, not a power study, an independent experiment, model efficiency evidence, a new generic testing method, or an improved original-instance minimax bound. Per-run counts need not be below expected bounds. Unsafe tables may validly receive statistical false certificates within the theorem's error allowance; observed false-certificate counts do not establish a general error rate.
protocol.output: One deterministic JSON artifact with 45 rows, source pins, exact truths and charged counts; no full acquisition traces or runtime measurements
protocol.prompt_pattern: Every prompt has the same declared rank pattern; no model, annotation service, or fresh-prompt population is sampled
protocol.randomness: Create a new Python random.Random(seed) for every run and pass its randrange method as randbelow; seeds are reused across scenarios and geometries
protocol.run_order: prompts, then scenarios, then seeds, in their listed orders
protocol.status: Fixed before the saved demonstration runs, after implementation tests; not external preregistration or an independent experiment
protocol.title: Frozen software demonstration of the cached likelihood reference auditor
protocol.trace_hash: SHA-256 streamed over acquisition-order UTF-8 JSON records, sorted keys and compact separators, followed by one LF per record; fields prompt_index,rank_index,loss,phase,budget,proposal_index; loss is str(Fraction), indices/counts are integers, absent values are null
protocol.truth: Compute exact risks independently from the fixed rank pattern and binomial winner weights, outside the engine; reveal labels to the engine only through its oracle callback
